title: Improvement, But Recession Continues in China
section_path: Improvement, But Recession Continues in China
section_path_text: Improvement, But Recession Continues in China
summary:
Main
By Jeffrey Landsberg
As we discussed in Commodore Research's most recent Weekly China Report, China's retail sales in September grew year-on-year by 1.1%. Taking September's 0.9% inflation into account, China's retail sales adjusted for inflation achieved increased year-on-year by 0.2%. Previously, inflation had exceeded retail sales growth in three of the prior five months.
